testimonials.title: What Our Community Says
testimonials.subtitle: Real stories from citizens making a difference

items.name: Priya Sharma
items.content: SAARTHI helped me get the street lights fixed in my neighborhood within a week. The community support and real-time updates made all the difference.

items.name: Rajesh Kumar
items.content: As a busy professional, I never had time to follow up on civic issues. SAARTHI's platform made it easy to report and track progress.

items.name: Anjali Patel
items.content: The AI categorization saved me so much time. I reported a drainage issue and it was resolved within 48 hours thanks to community collaboration.

items.name: Vikram Singh
items.content: SAARTHI has transformed how our community addresses civic problems. The transparency and community engagement is incredible.
